title: 12 Best Sleep inside a centuries-old thatched gassho-zukuri farmhouse in the UNESCO World Heritage village of Shirakawago.
description: Discover the 12 best gassho-zukuri farmhouses for an unforgettable overnight stay in Shirakawago, Japan. Experience UNESCO World Heritage charm, local cuisine, and timeless tradition.

places.name: Minsyuku Kidaiya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dinner and breakfast set meal, featuring grilled local river fish (iwana), sansai (mountain vegetables), and Hida beef.

places.name: Gassho-zukuri Minsyuku Kanjiro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy the traditional multi-course dinner (kaiseki) which often includes locally sourced mountain vegetables and Hida beef prepared with care.

places.name: Minsyuku Furusato
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The local specialty, 'Hoba Miso,' where miso is grilled on a magnolia leaf with vegetables and sometimes meat.

places.name: Shirakawago no Yu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The multi-course dinner featuring premium Hida beef steak and a relaxing soak in their natural hot spring baths.

places.name: Minsyuku Koemon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The set dinner and breakfast included in your stay, which typically features local vegetables, rice, and traditional Japanese sides.

places.name: Minsyuku Shimizu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The seasonal dinner, which adapts to the freshest local produce available, guaranteeing a unique culinary experience.

places.name: Minsyuku Yokichi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look forward to the grilled river fish (like 'ayu' in summer or 'iwana' in other seasons), a staple of the region's diet.

places.name: Minsyuku Ouraku
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The dinner spread, often featuring a small hot pot (nabe) with Hida beef and an assortment of local, seasonal vegetables.

places.name: Minsyuku Nodaniya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about trying some local 'doburoku' (unfiltered sake), a regional specialty often served during dinner.

places.name: Minsyuku Hisamatsu
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The traditional Japanese breakfast, featuring miso soup, rice, grilled fish, and various side dishes, often including homemade pickles.

places.name: Minsyuku Shironjya
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage in the communal dinner experience, which showcases local ingredients and provides an opportunity to chat with fellow travelers.

places.name: Minsyuku Otogi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Savor the thoughtfully prepared traditional Japanese dinner, which often includes locally foraged ingredients and exquisite presentation.
